references.text: Verse 8 presents the proposal that in verse 18 finds a hearing with the father and the son.
Verse 6 introduces the meeting between Hamor and Jacob, which leads to the successful persuasion in verse 18.
Verse 4 provides the basis for the negotiation that in verse 18 results in their words being heard.
Verse 18 describes the personal success that in verse 24 leads to the whole city being persuaded.
Verse 4 in Acts confirms the historical identity and kinship of the persons involved in the Genesis 34 event.
Verse 7 describes the offense that triggered the negotiations leading to a hearing in verse 18.
